title: Runbook not idempotent / no resume
evidence: runbook runs `gcloud spanner databases create` unconditionally under `set -euo pipefail` (no existence check: False); resume/skip-stage support: True. A re-run after success fails at stage 1; a failure after stage 3 cannot be resumed without dropping the DB.

evidence: upload uses `gcloud storage cp --recursive` without clearing the prefix (False) and the manifest uses a wildcard `<table>_part_*.csv` (True); stale shards from an earlier, larger export under the same GCS_PREFIX are loaded too (combined with K-05 local evidence).
